# Flowlight

> Free, open-source (GPL-3.0) macOS network monitor. It attributes every TCP/UDP flow to the app that made it and the domain it went to, keeps local history from second to year, and watches AI agents (including the tools and MCP servers they start) with per-agent allowlists and rules for data leaving the Mac. It can also refuse, once asked: a rule blocks an app, a destination or a URL for as long as you say, and a guardrail takes a tool away from an agent before its model is offered it. Current version: 0.4.0.

- [Flowlight privacy](https://flowlight.xinbetween.com/privacy/): What Flowlight records, where it stays, and every network request the app makes.
